edges: L.A.M.B. is a fashion line created by Gwen Stefani.
Gwen Stefani founded the fashion line L.A.M.B.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Fern Mallis praised L.A.M.B. and Gwen Stefani.
L.A.M.B. collaborated with LeSportsac for handbags.
Stefani designed a new line of handbags with Shifter and Partners.
L.A.M.B. joined with Royal Elastics for the shoe line.
L.A.M.B.'s watch line was the most successful watch launch at Nordstrom.
L.A.M.B. partnered with Vestal Group for a line of women's watches.
L.A.M.B. participated in New York Fashion Week.
Catherine Walsh announced a global licensing agreement with Stefani to develop fragrances for L.A.M.B.
Gwen Stefani launched an additional fashion line called Harajuku Lovers.
L.A.M.B. partnered with Coty Inc. for fragrance development.
